description: This source file defines the ViaNode class, which extends PcbNode and models a via element in a PCB design, including its position, size, and net association.

classes.name: ViaNode
classes.description: Represents a via element on a PCB with location, size, and net ID properties. Extends PcbNode and includes methods for initialization and connection checking.

methods.name: ViaNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ViaNode with a name, index, and child elements, extracting location, size, and net ID from the provided data.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ViaNode, primarily displaying its location.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Determines if a given PointNode is connected to this via based on location and size.
